overview.title: Overview
overview.description: This website is a personal portfolio. You can browse it without providing any information about yourself. Some features — the AI assistant, the email tool, the automation audit and appointment booking — transmit data to external service providers, and performance analytics only runs if you agree to it. The sections below set out each case, its purpose, its legal basis and how long anything is kept.
overview.keyPointDescription: You can read this site without identifying yourself. There is no advertising, no cross-site tracking and no profiling. At the same time, your IP address and anything you type into the assistant or the AI tools are personal data — the sections below explain exactly what happens to them, on what legal basis, and how long anything is kept.

hosting.title: Hosting and server logs
hosting.description: This website is hosted by Vercel Inc. When you open a page, your browser necessarily transmits your IP address, the requested address, the referring page, your browser identification and the time of the request. Vercel processes this data to deliver the site and to protect it against attacks and overload. The assistant and the AI tools additionally use your IP address for rate limiting, so that a single visitor cannot exhaust the service for everyone else.
hosting.legalBasis: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR — my legitimate interest in delivering a functioning, secure and abuse-resistant website.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.description: This site sets no advertising or tracking cookies. The following entries are stored on your device:

locale.title: Language preference (cookie)
locale.description: Stores the site language you selected and the language your browser reported, so the right version is shown on your next visit.

theme.title: Appearance preference (local storage)
theme.description: Stores whether you chose the light or the dark appearance.
theme.retention: Retention: until you clear your browser storage.

consent.title: Consent decision (local storage)
consent.description: Records whether you allowed or refused optional analytics, so you are not asked again on every page.
consent.retention: Retention: until you reset your choice or clear your browser storage.

chat.title: Assistant conversation (local storage)
chat.description: Holds the current conversation with the AI assistant, its session identifier and your consent choice for the assistant, so the thread survives navigation between pages and reloading the site.
chat.retention: Retention: remains in this browser until you clear the conversation in the assistant, use the deletion button below, or clear your browser storage.

cookies.legalBasis: Legal basis: § 25(2) TDDDG together with Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR — these entries are strictly necessary to provide the functions you requested. The analytics consent entry is stored under § 25(1) TDDDG and Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR.

analytics.title: Analytics and performance measurement
analytics.description: I use Vercel Web Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights to see which pages are visited and how quickly they load. Neither service sets cookies and neither builds a cross-site profile of you. They are nevertheless optional: the scripts are not loaded at all until you actively accept, and they are removed again as soon as you withdraw.
analytics.dataCollected: When active, these services process the page visited, the referring page, a coarse location derived from your IP address, your device type, operating system and browser. According to Vercel, the IP address itself is not stored and no identifier is persisted on your device.
analytics.legalBasis: Legal basis: your consent under Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR and § 25(1) TDDDG. You can withdraw it at any time with effect for the future, using the controls below.

controls.title: Your consent settings
controls.description: Withdrawing consent is as easy as giving it. Changes take effect immediately, in this tab and in any other tab you have open.
controls.statusUndecided: no choice recorded — nothing optional is loaded
controls.analyticsHint: Refusing keeps the site fully usable. Resetting your choice makes the consent banner appear again.
controls.chatLabel: Assistant data stored in this browser
controls.chatHint: This removes the conversation, the session identifier and your assistant consent choice from this browser. Conversations already saved on the server with your consent are not affected — write to the address above to have those deleted.

chatbot.title: AI assistant (Reem)
chatbot.description: This site includes an AI assistant that answers questions about my work. It is an artificial system, not a person, and its answers can be wrong or incomplete.
chatbot.alwaysTitle: What is always transmitted when you send a message
chatbot.alwaysDescription: Sending a message transmits its text to my server and from there to OpenAI, which generates the reply. The conversation is kept in your own browser, and so that follow-up questions have context the messages exchanged so far are sent along with each new message. Also transmitted are the page you were on, your browser language, your browser identification and a session identifier, and your IP address reaches my server as part of the request. This is unavoidable: without it the assistant cannot produce an answer. My server does not keep the conversation after it has answered. Requests are marked so that OpenAI does not store them and does not use them to train its models, but OpenAI may retain API data for a limited period for abuse monitoring under its own terms.
chatbot.storedTitle: What is stored only with your consent
chatbot.storedDescription: If you accept the assistant's consent prompt, the conversation is additionally written to my database: the messages, their timestamps, a shortened IP address, your browser language and your browser identification. If you decline, none of this is written — the exchange then exists only in your own browser.
chatbot.aiNoticeDescription: You are interacting with an AI system, not with me personally. Please do not enter passwords, payment details, health information or anything else you would not want processed by a US-based AI provider.
chatbot.legalBasis: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR for producing the answer you asked for; Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR — your consent — for storing the conversation.

aiTools.title: AI-backed tools
aiTools.description: Some tools on this site send the text you enter to external AI providers in order to produce a result. That text is processed to answer your request and is not stored by me afterwards.
aiTools.emailDescription: The email you paste, together with any context you add, is transmitted to Groq, Inc. for analysis and rewriting. Please do not enter personal data of third parties that you are not entitled to pass on.
aiTools.auditDescription: The answers you give in the audit are transmitted to OpenAI in order to generate the evaluation.
aiTools.legalBasis: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR — performing a service you actively requested; Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR for operating the tool securely.

booking.title: Appointment booking
booking.calendlyDescription: If you book a call, Calendly LLC processes the name, email address and any details you enter into its booking form, and sets its own cookies on its pages. I receive the information needed to hold the meeting. Calendly's own privacy policy applies to the booking process.
booking.legalBasis: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR — steps taken at your request prior to entering into a contract.

recipients.title: Recipients and international transfers
recipients.description: Personal data is passed to the following processors and service providers. Nothing is sold, and nothing is passed to anyone else unless I am legally required to do so.

vercel.name: Vercel Inc.
vercel.purpose: Hosting and delivery of this website, plus the optional analytics and performance measurement.
vercel.location: United States, with edge infrastructure in the EU.

openai.name: OpenAI, L.L.C. / OpenAI Ireland Ltd.
openai.purpose: Generates the AI assistant's replies and the automation audit result.

groq.name: Groq, Inc.
groq.purpose: Analyses and rewrites the text submitted to the email assistant.

recipients.transfersDescription: These providers are established in the United States, so your data is transferred outside the EU/EEA. Each of them offers a data processing agreement incorporating the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses; where a provider additionally holds a certification under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, that certification applies as well. Despite these safeguards, US authorities may have access rights that do not correspond to European standards, and enforcing your rights there can be harder than within the EU. If you would rather avoid this, simply do not use the assistant, the AI tools or the booking form — the rest of the site works without them.

retention.title: How long data is kept
retention.description: I keep personal data only for as long as it is needed for the purpose it was collected for, or for as long as statutory retention duties require.
retention.serverLogs: Hosting and request logs are kept by Vercel for the period set out in its own retention policy; I do not maintain separate access logs.
retention.chatSessions: My server keeps an assistant conversation only for as long as it takes to answer the message. Nothing about the exchange remains on the server once the reply has been sent, unless you consented to it being stored.
retention.chatRecords: Conversations stored in the database with your consent are currently deleted manually during review rather than on a fixed automatic schedule. You can have yours removed at any time by writing to the address above; I will do so without undue delay.
retention.browser: Entries in your own browser remain until they expire, until you clear your browser storage, or until you use the deletion button on this page.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.description: Under the GDPR you have the following rights in relation to your personal data:
rights.access: Right of access — to learn whether and what data about you is processed (Art. 15 GDPR).
rights.rectification: Right to rectification of inaccurate data (Art. 16 GDPR).
rights.restriction: Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR).
rights.objection: Right to object at any time, on grounds relating to your particular situation, to processing based on legitimate interests (Art. 21 GDPR).
rights.withdraw: Right to withdraw consent at any time with effect for the future, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out beforehand (Art. 7(3) GDPR).
rights.howTo: To exercise any of these rights, write to the email address given at the top of this page. I will respond within one month.
rights.complaintDescription: You may also lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority, in particular in the Member State of your residence, place of work or of the alleged infringement. The authority competent for me is:
rights.authorityName: Der Landesbeauftragte für den Datenschutz und die Informationsfreiheit Baden-Württemberg

notes.title: Good to know
notes.vat: All prices are final prices. No VAT is added — under the German small business regulation (§ 19 UStG) I do not charge VAT, so the price you see is the price you pay.
notes.included: Every package includes responsive design, an SEO and performance build (Lighthouse 90+), 2 revision rounds, and full handover documentation.
notes.notIncluded: Not included in any package: content — texts, images, logos — and third-party licences, stock media or paid fonts. You supply these.
notes.runningCosts: Running costs — hosting, database, AI usage and domain — are billed to you directly by your chosen providers, on your own accounts.
notes.rights: Full usage rights to the delivered work are transferred to you on final payment.
notes.warranty: Two weeks of free bugfixing after launch are included. Your statutory warranty rights remain unaffected.
notes.payment: Payment: up to 1.000 € the full amount is invoiced after acceptance; above 1.000 € it's 40% on order and 60% after acceptance, 14 days net.
notes.rates: Additional work beyond the agreed scope is billed at 70 €/h, always quoted and approved first. An extra revision round is 190 €. Feedback within 5 working days, acceptance within 10.
